## Evidence

Attach a screenshot or the smallest permitted, anonymized example. Include a
redacted error message or traceback when available. Do not upload passwords,
session cookies, report verification tokens, claimant details, private `data/`,
backup archives or imagery you do not have permission to redistribute.

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Reproduced after retrying in a new test project
- [ ] Uses actual imagery/telemetry
- [ ] Uses a synthetic fixture or simulator (identify it explicitly)
